contact.name: Helen Brown
contact.evidence_quote: Since 1996 Le Verseau Secondary has been called Ecole Internationale le Verseau – ELCE, having merged with a Hairdressing and Beautician school called Ecole Libre de Coiffure et d’Esthétique, situated in the centre of Gosselies, making one legal entity. In practice, the Head Teacher, Helen Brown, has overall responsibility for both school sites, assisted by two Deputy Head Teachers, one in each location. external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Students in the Kindergarten and Primary sections benefit from an enhanced and tailored English curriculum from an early age. This learning opportunity is made possible thanks to donations from the association Les Amis du Verseau.
In Secondary school the Enhanced English Programme is provided as an extra-curricular activity through another of our not-for-profit partners, Verseau Sports, Arts & Langues (VSAL).

Afin de bénéficier de toute la liberté pédagogique nécessaire à cette intégration, l’apprentissage de l’anglais est proposé à nos élèves sous la forme d’activités parascolaires facultatives, organisées par notre partenaire « Le Verseau Sports Arts & Langues (VSAL) ».
